rows.summary: Review of the R6a (Bullet Optimizer) rows, all verdicts HOLD, no code change. Fail-first run 36518113356 (green): 8e97533 (DPH-30), e3b2030 (DVIS-07, DPH-37, DPH-38, and DVIS-23's test), d529431 (DPH-41), e4cc82f (DPH-42) each fail without their src change and pass with it; full gate 36463569183 on 9d40631 green. Code read at HEAD: textarea pointer-coarse:text-base (DPH-30/36); kit Dialog size lg, max-sm:h-dvh, overlay max-sm:p-0, body min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto (DPH-37); footer flex-wrap, kit buttons, Copy mr-auto (DPH-38); tiles grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 (DPH-41/43); verb row and categories flex-wrap, no max-w-[280px]/overflow-x-auto (DPH-42); the Dialog's own portal (DVIS-23, via 56e42bf; 5f52d43's outer Portal is gone, proven against e3b2030 in 36453755199 and again in 36518113356). Two claims were superseded on purpose: DVIS-07's 'Escape closes even after a rewrite' is reversed by R5-OPT-01, and DVIS-23's 'inside the kit Portal' is now the Dialog's portal.
rows.remaining: DPH-30/36/37/38 and DVIS-07 stay partial in the tracker only for their non-optimizer dialogs (Cover Letter Generator, Header Icon picker, NewLetter, ShareLink), which are the dlg cluster's scope.

rows.summary: Now: 'Restore my statement' stays after a template through typing, Auto-Fix, chips and more template picks, and brings back the user's own statement; it goes once used or once the text is that statement again. Fail-first run 36456232667.

Now: Escape closes the optimizer only while the statement is unchanged; after a rewrite it is ignored, and the ignored Escape stops at the optimizer so an issue dialog around the editor stays open. Fail-first runs 36456232667 (bea64b2), 36457682925 (0e3e18d).
Now: body text after a list (a blockquote, a <dd>, a paragraph) ends the open ATS bullet and is not scored as a bullet. Fail-first run 36456232667.

Now: the optimizer opens a list item's whole own statement (text before and after a nested list), as the ATS scores it, and Apply rewrites it keeping the sub-list, leaving no
or empty paragraph (checked in Chromium). Fail-first runs 36456882224 (39a5788), 36462478655 (058d471, 9d40631).

Now: the ATS score and the optimizer read one weak-phrase list, every phrase with an Auto-Fix; a power-verb chip leaves a statement opening with a helper verb or negation (Did not, Was, Never, Could not, Can't, Won't) unchanged and shows a rewrite tip, and keeps 'efforts to' after 'Led'. The negative-chip part was filed as R4-SW-WT-04 in the commits. Fail-first runs 36456882224 (bc196c0, 837fc9b), 36459969462 (abe8409, fe78717).

notes: Full gate on 9d40631: run 36463569183 green (suite 6/6, Playwright 3/3, Cypress 4/4, build, lint). Merges with claude/r4-green cleanly (git merge-tree). r4-green's Dialog makes a closing panel inert and pointer-events-none; the optimizer's Escape handling is in its onClose(reason) and Dialog's keydown on the wrapper, and close() is a no-op once open is false, so it is compatible. 5f52d43 is not re-proven on its own: 56e42bf removed its outer Portal, so the DVIS-23 test is proven against e3b2030 (the Dialog's portal).
